<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Brittle Star on a Barrel Sponge</title>

  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #051923;
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    #stage {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .hud {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      color: #e9fbff;
    }

    .title {
      position: absolute;
      top: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px);
      left: clamp(20px, 4vw, 52px);
      max-width: 420px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: #78e6df;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3.1rem);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.05;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    }

    .subtitle {
      max-width: 360px;
      margin: 14px 0 0;
      color: rgba(224, 247, 252, 0.66);
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .controls {
      position: absolute;
      right: clamp(16px, 3vw, 36px);
      bottom: clamp(16px, 3vw, 30px);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .hint {
      color: rgba(224, 247, 252, 0.55);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    button {
      border: 1px solid rgba(153, 235, 235, 0.25);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 9px 14px;
      color: #e9fbff;
      background: rgba(7, 35, 45, 0.68);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: rgba(18, 65, 78, 0.82);
      border-color: rgba(153, 235, 235, 0.5);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .species {
      position: absolute;
      left: clamp(20px, 4vw, 52px);
      bottom: clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      color: rgba(224, 247, 252, 0.48);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .species::before {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;

      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(243, 162, 93, 0.8);
      content: "";
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {

        max-width: 280px;
      }

        display: none;
      }

  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div id="stage"></div>

  <div class="hud">
    <div class="title">
      <p class="eyebrow">Deep-sea study No. 07</p>
      <h1>Brittle Star</h1>
      <p class="subtitle">
        A delicate octocoral rests across the rounded rim of a porous barrel sponge,
        its five long, jointed arms curling down the sponge at unequal angles.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="species">Ophiuroidea · procedural natural history</div>

    <div class="controls">
      <span class="hint">Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom</span>
      <button id="resetView" type="button">Reset view</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const stage = document.getElementById("stage");

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      alpha: false,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    stage.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x061b25);
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x061b25, 0.047);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural sponge texture
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    function createSpongeTexture() {
      const size = 512;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = size;
      canvas.height = size;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const image = context.createImageData(size, size);

      for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
          const index = (y * size + x) * 4;
          const grain = Math.random() * 20 - 10;
          const wave =
            Math.sin(x * 0.055 + Math.sin(y * 0.025) * 2.2) * 4 +
            Math.sin(y * 0.08) * 2;

          image.data[index] = 218 + grain + wave;
          image.data[index + 1] = 112 + grain * 0.55 + wave * 0.5;
          image.data[index + 2] = 57 + grain * 0.35;
          image.data[index + 3] = 255;
        }
      }

      context.putImageData(image, 0, 0);

      // Dark, irregular pores.
      for (let i = 0; i < 520; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * size;
        const y = Math.random() * size;
        const radius = 1.2 + Math.random() * 7;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = `rgba(65, 29, 16, ${0.12 + Math.random() * 0.38})`;
        context.shadowBlur = 3 + Math.random() * 5;
        context.shadowColor = "rgba(35, 15, 8, 0.65)";
        context.fill();
      }

      // Fine fibrous ridges and lighter pore rims.
      context.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * size;
        const y = Math.random() * size;
        const length = 3 + Math.random() * 18;

        context.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 187, 116, ${0.035 + Math.random() * 0.08})`;
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(x, y);
        context.lineTo(x + length, y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2);
        context.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 220; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * size;
        const y = Math.random() * size;
        const radius = 1.5 + Math.random() * 4;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 194, 125, 0.22)";
        context.fill();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2.1, 1.25);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      return texture;
    }

    function createSandTexture() {
      const size = 256;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = size;
      canvas.height = size;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const image = context.createImageData(size, size);

      for (let i = 0; i < image.data.length; i += 4) {
        const value = 35 + Math.random() * 20;
        image.data[i] = value;
        image.data[i + 1] = value + 2;
        image.data[i + 2] = value + 3;
        image.data[i + 3] = 255;
      }

      context.putImageData(image, 0, 0);

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(12, 12);

      return texture;
    }

    const spongeTexture = createSpongeTexture();
    const spongeBump = spongeTexture.clone();
    spongeBump.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    spongeBump.needsUpdate = true;

    const spongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf09a61,
      map: spongeTexture,
      bumpMap: spongeBump,
      bumpScale: 0.055,
      roughness: 0.96,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const armMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf3a15b,
      roughness: 0.76,
      metalness: 0,
      bumpMap: spongeTexture,
      bumpScale: 0.025
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x9cefff, 0x2b170f, 1.45));

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0d5, 3.2);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 7, 5.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -2;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 18;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x45d9ff, 24, 12, 2);
    rimLight.position.set(-3.5, 3.2, -3.2);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    const warmFill = new THREE.PointLight(0xff8a4c, 13, 9, 2);
    warmFill.position.set(3, 1.2, 2.5);
    scene.add(warmFill);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Seafloor
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(24, 96),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x18333a,
        map: createSandTexture(),
        roughness: 1,
        metalness: 0
      })
    );

    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floor.position.y = 0;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Barrel sponge
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const spongeHeight = 2.16;
    const spongeGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
      1.48,
      1.66,
      spongeHeight,
      96,
      4,
      false
    );

    // Slightly organic deformation while preserving a flat top.
    const spongePositions = spongeGeometry.attributes.position;

    for (let i = 0; i < spongePositions.count; i++) {
      let x = spongePositions.getX(i);
      let y = spongePositions.getY(i);
      let z = spongePositions.getZ(i);

      const isTop = Math.abs(y - spongeHeight / 2) < 0.012;
      const angle = Math.atan2(z, x);
      const radius = Math.hypot(x, z);

      if (!isTop) {
        const deformation =
          1 +
          0.012 * Math.sin(angle * 7 + y * 1.8) +
          0.007 * Math.sin(angle * 13 - y * 2.7) +
          0.004 * Math.sin(y * 4.1);

        x *= deformation;
        z *= deformation;
      }

      spongePositions.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }

    spongePositions.needsUpdate = true;
    spongeGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    const sponge = new THREE.Mesh(spongeGeometry, spongeMaterial);
    sponge.position.y = spongeHeight / 2;
    sponge.castShadow = true;
    sponge.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(sponge);

    const spongeRim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.515, 0.105, 18, 112),
      spongeMaterial
    );

    spongeRim.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    spongeRim.position.y = spongeHeight;
    spongeRim.castShadow = true;
    spongeRim.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(spongeRim);

    // A darker interior visible in the open top.
    const spongeInterior = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(1.42, 96),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x6b2d1c,
        roughness: 1,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      })
    );

    spongeInterior.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    spongeInterior.position.y = spongeHeight - 0.012;
    spongeInterior.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(spongeInterior);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Brittle star: central disc
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const organism = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(organism);

    const discProfile = [
      new THREE.Vector2(0.0, 0.0),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.16, 0.012),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.3, 0.045),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.4, 0.105),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.455, 0.19),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.465, 0.225),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.44, 0.245),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.39, 0.205),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.32, 0.115),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.2, 0.055),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.0, 0.035)
    ];

    const disc = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.LatheGeometry(discProfile, 72),
      armMaterial
    );

    disc.position.y = 2.185;
    disc.castShadow = true;
    disc.receiveShadow = true;
    organism.add(disc);

    const hub = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.115, 24, 16),
      armMaterial
    );

    hub.scale.y = 0.55;
    hub.position.y = 2.43;
    hub.castShadow = true;
    organism.add(hub);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Five long, jointed, differently bent arms
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const unitCylinder = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 12, 1);
    const jointGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12);

    function createJointedArm(angle, variant) {
      const radial = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(angle),
        0,
        Math.sin(angle)
      );

      const tangent = new THREE.Vector3(
        -Math.sin(angle),
        0,
        Math.cos(angle)
      );

      const bend = variant.bend * 0.85 + variant.lift;
      const points = [
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(0.12).setY(2.405),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(0.62).setY(2.48 + variant.lift * 0.15),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(1.18).addScaledVector(tangent, 0.18).setY(2.52),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(1.72).addScaledVector(tangent, bend * 0.55).setY(2.37),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(2.13).addScaledVector(tangent, bend).setY(1.9),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(2.04).addScaledVector(tangent, bend * 1.25).setY(1.28),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(1.67).addScaledVector(tangent, bend * 1.75).setY(0.79),
        radial.clone().multiplyScalar(1.18).addScaledVector(tangent, bend * 2.05).setY(0.62)
      ];

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        points,
        false,
        "catmullrom",
        0.48
      );

      const radiusProfile = [
        0.075,
        0.07,
        0.062,
        0.052,
        0.044,
        0.036,
        0.029,
        0.022
      ];

      const segments = 58;

      for (let i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
        const t0 = i / segments;
        const t1 = (i + 1) / segments;

        const point0 = curve.getPointAt(t0);
        const point1 = curve.getPointAt(t1);

        const direction = point1.clone().sub(point0);
        const length = direction.length();
        const midpoint = point0.clone().add(point1).multiplyScalar(0.5);

        const radiusBottom = radiusProfile[i];
        const radiusTop = radiusProfile[i + 1];

        const segment = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radiusTop, radiusBottom, length, 12),
          armMaterial
        );

        segment.position.copy(midpoint);
        segment.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
          direction.normalize()
        );
        segment.castShadow = true;
        segment.receiveShadow = true;
        organism.add(segment);
      }

      // Rounded joints emphasize the brittle star's segmented anatomy.
      for (let i = 1; i <= segments; i++) {
        const point = curve.getPointAt(i / segments);
        const radius = radiusProfile[Math.min(i, radiusProfile.length - 1)];

        const joint = new THREE.Mesh(
          jointGeometry,
          armMaterial
        );

        joint.position.copy(point);
        joint.scale.setScalar(radius * 1.08);
        joint.castShadow = true;
        joint.receiveShadow = true;
        organism.add(joint);
      }
    }

    const armVariants = [
      { angle: 0.02, bend: 1, lift: 0.0 },
      { angle: Math.PI / 5, bend: -1, lift: 0.12 },
      { angle: (2 * Math.PI) / 5, bend: 1, lift: 0.18 },
      { angle: (3 * Math.PI) / 5, bend: -1, lift: 0.08 },
      { angle: (4 * Math.PI) / 5, bend: 1, lift: 0.16 }
    ];

    armVariants.forEach((variant) => {
      createJointedArm(variant.angle, variant);
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Suspended particles
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const particleCount = 180;
    const particlePositions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particlePositions[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16;
      particlePositions[i * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 5.5 + 0.1;
      particlePositions[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16;
    }

    const particleGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    particleGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(particlePositions, 3)
    );

    const particles = new THREE.Points(
      particleGeometry,
      new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        color: 0x9edce0,
        size: 0.035,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.38,
        depthWrite: false,
        sizeAttenuation: true
      })
    );

    scene.add(particles);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Direct camera controls: orbit, zoom, and reset
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.35, 0);

    const defaultView = {
      theta: 0.72,
      phi: 1.12,
      radius: 7.25
    };

    let theta = defaultView.theta;
    let phi = defaultView.phi;
    let radius = defaultView.radius;
    let dragging = false;
    let previousX = 0;
    let previousY = 0;

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(phi);

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(theta),
        target.y + radius * Math.cos(phi),
        target.z + radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    function resetView() {
      theta = defaultView.theta;
      phi = defaultView.phi;
      radius = defaultView.radius;
      updateCamera();
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      dragging = true;
      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;
      renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;

      const deltaX = event.clientX - previousX;
      const deltaY = event.clientY - previousY;

      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;

      theta -= deltaX * 0.006;
      phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(phi - deltaY * 0.005, 0.38, 1.48);

      updateCamera();
    });

    function stopDragging(event) {
      dragging = false;

      if (
        event.pointerId !== undefined &&
        renderer.domElement.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)
      ) {
        renderer.domElement.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDragging);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDragging);

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          radius + event.deltaY * 0.006,
          4.1,
          12
        );
        updateCamera();
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", resetView);
    document.getElementById("resetView").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    });

    updateCamera();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animation
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();

      particles.rotation.y = elapsed * 0.018;
      particles.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.22) * 0.08;

      rimLight.intensity = 23 + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.7) * 1.5;
      warmFill.intensity = 12 + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.48 + 1.4) * 0.8;

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>
